system.flavor:
Swing a companion from one ledge to another, sweep a bench out of your path, set a drunk down in the corner where he will do no harm, keep your feet on a rolling deck, or walk a beam with a load on your back.

Not enough to throw someone across a room.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and move the target to another empty space adjacent to you.

surges.html: You may move 1 unit before moving the target.

rider.title: Adaptation - Titan
rider.html: Assume Counterweight (upkeep 0): you cannot be made Prone by ordinary terrain; other sources can still knock you Prone.
